name: app-6a9da9955aa88191914c3d0813de3cdc
description: Track meals, nutrition, workouts, sleep, and your overall habits with Day.new.

interface.longDescription: Track meals, nutrition, workouts, sleep, and your overall habits in the AI chat you already use. Save meal records and custom daily trackers, retrieve nutrition totals, and compare recorded patterns across days. Saved records stay organized in Day.new. Workout and sleep tracking uses manually logged durations; no device sync is implied. For personal wellness, not medical diagnosis or treatment.
defaultPrompt: Log a turkey sandwich and an apple for lunch in Day.new.
What meals have I logged today in Day.new?
Show my meals for September 1, 2026 in Day.new.

positive.prompt: Show my Day.new meals for September 1, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the reviewer account sample meals for 2026-09-01 using its local UTC offset; do not write.

positive.prompt: What meals have I logged today in Day.new?
positive.expected_behavior: Read today using the local date and UTC offset, returning stored meals and totals without writing.

positive.prompt: Log lunch in Day.new today: turkey sandwich, 400 calories, 30g protein, 40g carbs, 13g fat.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one lunch preserving the supplied nutrition; confirm only after success.

positive.prompt: Save a snack in Day.new today: apple (95 calories, 0g protein, 25g carbs, 0g fat) and yogurt (100 calories, 17g protein, 6g carbs, 0g fat).
positive.expected_behavior: Create one snack with two items and totals of 195 calories, 17g protein, 31g carbs, 0g fat.

positive.prompt: Log salmon, rice and broccoli as dinner in Day.new today; estimate portions and nutrition.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify estimates, save one dinner and confirm the returned record.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not write any Day.new record.
Do not call a write tool; explain deletion is not supported by the connector and direct the user to Day.new.

negative.prompt: Diagnose diabetes from my Day.new meals.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not diagnose or write a meal; explain that meal records cannot establish a diagnosis.

publication.release_notes: Adds tested deletion and diagnosis boundaries, independent email-code reviewer access, and recorded meal and custom-tracking evidence.
